item.text:
The next investigation was the 1,000-seed expansion of the randomized campaign and a fix-stack stress test. It confirmed the new F25 defect and the remediation’s behavior at larger scale.

- Captured build at 1,000 seeds: **407 pass / 582 NOOP-on-all losses / 11 mixed divergences** ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_random_fault_1000_output.txt)).
- F1/F2/F20/F21/F25 stack in `diagnostic_fix13/`: **818 pass / 182 legitimate NOOP losses / 0 divergence** ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix13_campaign1000_output.txt)).

**F25** is the recovery fallback checking `cmds != nil`; decoded zero-length command lists are non-nil, so phase 1 proposes and commits an empty command instead of NOOP. The deterministic handler test fails on the captured code ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_recovery_noop_output.txt)), and `diagnostic_fix13/` validates the `len(cmds) > 0` guard. The captured suite is now **40 failing finding tests and 5 passing controls**; `run_audit.sh` asserts those counts and now refreshes the 100-, 500-, and 1,000-seed sweeps.

Updated artifacts: [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/report.md) (25 findings), [executive_summary.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/executive_summary.md), [validation_matrix.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/validation_matrix.md), and [remediation.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/remediation.md).
